description:
A test support library that lets Filament components be tested at four levels of fidelity:

  Rung 1 — Domain logic: plain ExUnit, pure OTP. No Filament infrastructure needed.
             (Not a track ticket — already covered by unit tests in Tracks B/C/D/E.)

  Rung 2 — Component isolated (F1): mount a single fiber, drive it with
             click/submit, assert on rendered HTML. No WebSocket. Observable
             dependencies replaced by stubs (F4).

  Rung 3 — Subtree + real observable (F2): like Rung 2 but with a real
             (test-started) observable GenServer. update/1 drains messages;
             eventually/2 retries assertions with a timeout.

  Rung 4 — End-to-end (F3): thin wrapper around Phoenix.LiveViewTest for
             full LiveView integration tests.

  Stub builder (F4): Filament.Test.StubObservable + Filament.Test.Stub API +
             observable_stubs injection at mount time.

Execution order: F4 (stub infra) → F1 (Rung 2) → F2 (Rung 3) → F3 (Rung 4).

Build plan: filament/.tmp/plan.html § Track F

Prerequisites:
  Track B fully merged (flm-t8j — all closed ✓)
  Track C fully merged (flm-oue — all closed ✓)
  Track D D4 merged (flm-hom.4) before F4 can modify use_observable/3
  Track E E3 merged (flm-zoc.3) before F1 can test event dispatch

F is on the critical path — Track H (tests) imports Track G (examples) which use
the Filament.Test API delivered here.
title: Track F: Test harness — four-rung test API for Filament components
